entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: ¶I made a covenant with mine eyes; and how should I fix my regard upon a maid?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what would have been [my] portion of +God from above, and what the heritage of the Almighty from on high?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: Is not calamity for the unrighteous? and misfortune for the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Doth not he see my ways, and number all my steps?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot hath hasted to deceit,

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: (Let me be weighed in an even balance, and +God will take knowledge of my blamelessness;)

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my step have turned out of the way, and my heart followed mine eyes, and if any blot cleaveth to my hands;

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: Let me sow, and another eat; and let mine offspring be rooted out.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: ¶If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, so that I laid wait at my neighbour's door,

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: Let my wife grind for another, and let others bow down upon her.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For this is an infamy; yea, it is an iniquity [to be judged by] the judges:

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: If I have despised the cause of my bondman or of my bondmaid, when they contended with me,

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: What then should I do when *God riseth up? and if he visited, what should I answer him?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not One fashion us in the womb?

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: ¶If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: Or have eaten my morsel alone, so that the fatherless ate not thereof,

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: (For from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, and I have guided the [widow] from my mother's womb;)

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: If I have seen any perishing for want of clothing, or any needy without covering;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my lambs;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: If I have lifted up my hand against an orphan, because I saw my help in the gate:

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: [Then] let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone!

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For calamity from *God was a terror to me, and by reason of his excellency I was powerless.

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: ¶If I have made gold my hope, or said to the fine gold, My confidence!

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: If I beheld the sun when it shone, or the moon walking in brightness,

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: And my heart have been secretly enticed, so that my mouth kissed my hand:

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: This also would be an iniquity for the judge, for I should have denied the *God who is above.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, and exulted when evil befell him;

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: (Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse;)

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: If the men of my tent said not, Who shall find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat? --

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: The stranger did not lodge without; I opened my doors to the pathway.

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: ¶If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom,

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: Because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and went not out of the door, ...

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: Oh that I had one to hear me! Behold my signature: let the Almighty answer me! And let mine opponent write an accusation!

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Would I not take it upon my shoulder? I would bind it on to me [as] a crown;

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I come near to him.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: If my land cry out against me, and its furrows weep together;

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, and have tormented to death the souls of its owners:

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and tares instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
